narration.en: Today, one goal: finish on time.

narration.zh: 骑不动，就给腿换个引擎。
narration.en: When my legs complain, I upgrade the engine.

narration.zh: 下车，过街，打工模式启动。
narration.en: Out of the car, across the street. Employee mode: on.

narration.zh: 人还没开工，脑内先模拟一遍。
narration.en: Before starting work, my brain runs a simulation.

narration.zh: 预演结束，该回到现实了。
narration.en: Rehearsal over. Back to the real world.

narration.zh: 还是两个轮子。这次，不赶了。
narration.en: Two wheels again. This time, no rush.

transition.purpose: Entering and leaving an explicitly fictional work simulation
